This enables MCP clients, such as ChatGPT, to make pay-per-call requests without relying on static subscriptions or API keys. The goal is to allow AI agents and applications to pay only for what they use, automatically and transparently. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))
